text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You've been watching over me 
all this time, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Watching over me, and over everyone else— 
all the Umamusume, since long, long ago.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Your feelings now dwell firmly in my 
heart. Leave it to me—I swear I'll turn 
them into strength.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Keep watching over me, Goddesses. —Over 
the destiny that I will carve out."
